_comment: Where conversations on retired models go next, for scripts/migrate-conversations.sh.
A conversation stores the endpoint and model its NEXT turn uses. This table
moves that forward when a model is retired; it never touches messages, which
record what actually answered. See scripts/lib/conversation-migration.js.
targets: the complete set of conversation fields a moved conversation ends up
with. null removes a field. Each target must look like a conversation the UI
would have created itself: for the custom endpoint that means endpointType,
the matching modelSpecs `spec`, useResponsesApi, and the context limit that
conversations on that model already carry. .github/workflows/validate.yml
checks that every endpoint, spec and model here exists in the configuration.
sources: per endpoint, the models that stay (keep) and where the others go
(map). A model on a listed endpoint that is in neither stops the run.
Endpoints not listed are never touched; `agents` conversations follow their
agent, which scripts/migrate-agent-models.sh handles.
Mapping rule, as for agents: same-tier successor. Cheaper old OpenAI models
go to Luna (John, 2026-10-13, UPGRADE_PLAN M15).
2026-10-13, interim pass (UPGRADE_PLAN Phase 0 step 7): the built-in openAI
endpoint is no longer offered but still served 66 active old conversations.
They move to the GPT-5.6 custom endpoint, so the OPENAI_MODELS allowlist can
then shrink. Conversations on retired Claude models already fail to continue
(the anthropic list is enforced), so they move to their successors in the
same pass. Phase 3 replaces this table with the GPT-6 one.
2026-10-15 (UPGRADE_PLAN Phase 3, M13/M15): the GPT-6 table. Every
conversation on the retired custom endpoint, and any left on the built-in
openAI endpoint on an older model, moves to the built-in openAI endpoint on
GPT-6. endpointType goes (built-in conversations have none). The spec is the
preset of the same model, as if the user had picked it: Luna -> quick, Sol ->
standard. maxContextTokens is those presets' 250000, below the 272K tier
where GPT-6 prices double; the old 380000 would cross it. useResponsesApi is
set true, which also clears any stored false (M14). Claude conversations go
to the 5.5 model of the same family, on the raw selector (no spec).
specs: retired modelSpecs names and their successors, for favorites pinned in
the model selector (saved presets and conversations carry their spec in the
targets above). The same scripts also move saved presets, which have the same
fields as a conversation, and favorites on a retired endpoint and model.
